title: Are we too fixated on protein?
speaker: BBC Learning English

sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好,这是6分钟英语 从英国广播公司学习英语。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Georgie. Neil, we're talking about protein today.
sentences.zh: 我是尼尔,我是乔治 尼尔,我们今天讨论的是蛋白质

sentences.en: What type of protein do you usually eat?
sentences.zh: 你通常吃什么蛋白质?

sentences.en: Well, I like all kinds of proteins – fish, bit of chicken – but I think I really like an egg.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢各种蛋白质——鱼,鸡肉—— 但我想我真的喜欢鸡蛋。

sentences.en: An egg is my favourite kind of protein. Ah, I was going to say that too.
sentences.zh: 蛋是我最喜欢的蛋白质

sentences.en: I'm a big fan of breakfast foods and eggs are my favourite.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢吃早餐 鸡蛋是我的最爱

sentences.en: Well, you can't beat a good breakfast! Of all the main food groups, such as carbohydrate, fat and fibre, it's protein that seems to be most in the news.
sentences.zh: 好吃的早餐你打不过的 碳水化合物、脂肪和纤维等所有主要食品组中 蛋白质是新闻中最流行的

sentences.en: In shops and on social media, you'll find all kinds of high-protein foods being advertised, from shakes and yoghurts to chocolate.
sentences.zh: 在商店和社交媒体上, 你会发现各种高蛋白质食品 被广告宣传, 从摇摆和酸奶到巧克力。

sentences.en: Here's Ruth Alexander, presenter of BBC World Service programme The Food Chain: Cast your eye over most aisles in the supermarkets now and you'll see high protein products in abundance: pasta made with lentils and chickpeas rather than wheat flour, bread fortified with beans and pulses.
sentences.zh: 这是Ruth Alexander, 英国广播公司世界服务节目的主持人 食物链:你的眼睛 覆盖了超市大多数的过道 现在,你会看到高蛋白质产品 丰富的: 面条是用扁豆和小鸡豆做的,而不是面粉,面包加了豆类和豆类。

sentences.en: Ruth casts her eye over the supermarket shelves.
sentences.zh: 露丝在超市货架上投下她的眼睛

sentences.en: If you cast your eye over something, you take a quick look at it.
sentences.zh: 如果你把目光投向某事, 你快看一眼它。

sentences.en: What she sees are protein products in abundance – in other words, in large quantities.
sentences.zh: 她看到的是丰富的蛋白质产品,换句话说,数量很大。

sentences.en: Products which already contain protein, like yoghurt, are re-packaged as 'high-protein', while other items have extra protein added, often in the form of beans and pulses.
sentences.zh: 已经含有蛋白质的产品,如酸奶,被重新包装为“高蛋白”,而其他物品则增加额外的蛋白质,通常以豆类和豆类的形式。

sentences.en: Protein is big business! Our bodies need protein for health and to build muscle, but with all this focus on protein, are we forgetting about other important nutrients, such as fibre?
sentences.zh: 蛋白质是大生意! 我们的身体需要蛋白质来维持健康, 并培养肌肉, 但是,由于这些对蛋白质的关注, 我们是否忘记了其他重要的营养物质,比如纤维?

sentences.en: That's what we'll be discussing in this programme, hearing some useful new words and phrases.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这个节目中要讨论的, 听到一些有用的新词和短语。

sentences.en: But first I have a question for you, Georgie.
sentences.zh: 但首先我要问你一个问题 乔治

sentences.en: The popularity of protein started with bodybuilders and people working out in gyms, who ate extra protein to gain muscle.
sentences.zh: 蛋白质的流行始于健美师和健身房的人, 他们吃额外的蛋白质来获得肌肉。

sentences.en: Irishman Patrick Callahan is a big name in the protein-muscle world, but do you know who he is?
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰人Patrick Callahan是蛋白质肌肉世界的大人物 但你知道他是谁吗?

sentences.en: Is he: a) the owner of a company which makes protein shakes, b) the winner of the 2024 Mister Universe bodybuilding contest, or c) the scientist who discovered a new protein in outer space?
sentences.zh: 他:(a) 一家制造蛋白质摇晃的公司的所有者,(b) 2024年环球先生健美比赛的赢家,或(c) 在外层空间发现新蛋白质的科学家?

sentences.en: Ooh, I'm going to say Patrick Callahan is the winner of the 2024 Mister Universe bodybuilding contest.
sentences.zh: 我要说帕特里克・卡拉汉是2024年 环球先生健美比赛的赢家

sentences.en: OK. We'll find out if you're right at the end.
sentences.zh: 好,我们最后会发现你是否对

sentences.en: Marketing campaigns that promote sales of high-protein food are certainly working.
sentences.zh: 推广高蛋白质食品销售的营销运动当然在起作用。

sentences.en: Sales of protein products make around £7 billion globally.
sentences.zh: 全球蛋白质产品的销售量约为70亿英镑。

sentences.en: Here's Scott Dicker from SPINS, a market research company in Chicago, talking with BBC programme The Food Chain: So, sometimes carbs are good; sometimes they're bad for consumers.
sentences.zh: 这是芝加哥一家市场研究公司Scott Dicker, 与英国广播公司的节目“食物链:所以有时碳水化合物是好的;有时对消费者有害。

sentences.en: Sometimes fat is good; sometimes it's bad for consumers.
sentences.zh: 有时脂肪是好的,有时对消费者有害。

sentences.en: But protein seems to have this continuous health halo on it.
sentences.zh: 但蛋白质上似乎有这种持续的健康光环

sentences.en: Unlike carbs – that's carbohydrates – and fat, consumers don't see any downside to eating protein.
sentences.zh: 与碳水化合物 — — 即碳水化合物 — — 和脂肪不同,消费者不会看到吃蛋白质的不利之处。

sentences.en: Scott says protein has a health halo, a marketing term which describes perceiving a food to be healthy based on a single feature, such as being 'organic', 'gluten-free' or in this case 'high-protein', even if its overall nutritional value is poor.
sentences.zh: Scott说蛋白质有一个健康光环, 一个营销术语, 描述一种食物基于一个单一的特性, 比如“ 有机的 ”, “无糖” 或者“高蛋白 ”, 即使它的总体营养价值很低 。

sentences.en: Yes, food which used to be considered unhealthy is now called healthy just because a spoonful of protein powder has been added.
sentences.zh: 是的,过去被认为是不健康的食品现在被称为健康食品,仅仅因为添加了一勺蛋白质粉。

sentences.en: So, could our modern obsession with protein mean that we ignore other important food groups, like fibre?
sentences.zh: 那么,我们现代对蛋白质的痴迷 是否意味着我们忽略了其他重要的食物群体,比如纤维?

sentences.en: NHS surgeon and blogger Dr Karan Rajan thinks so and explains why here to Ruth Alexander, on BBC World Service programme The Food Chain: And do you think we're paying enough attention to fibre?
sentences.zh: NHS外科医生兼博客Karan Rajan博士认为如此,

sentences.en: Historically, probably not. I think the tide is turning, and there's more people interested in fibre and optimising their fibre intake and fibermaxxing even – it's a trend on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看,也许不是。 我认为潮流正在转变, 更多的人对纤维感兴趣, 并且甚至对纤维的摄取和纤维光化也感兴趣 — — 这是TikTok的趋势。

sentences.en: What is fibermaxxing? Fibermaxxing is, you know, as it suggests, similar to the protein-maxing trend, where people are trying to maximise their fibre intake with little hacks or tricks or tips they could do, whether it's, you know, adding certain seeds or nuts to snacks.
sentences.zh: 纤维成形法是什么?如其所示, 纤维成形法与蛋白质成形法相似, 人们试图用小的黑客或小把戏或小把戏 来最大限度地增加纤维的摄入量, 不管是给零食添加种子或坚果。

sentences.en: Many people pay more attention to protein than fibre in their diet, but Dr Karan thinks the tide is turning – an idiom which means that things are changing.
sentences.zh: 许多人对蛋白质的关注比食物中的纤维要多, 但卡伦医生认为潮流正在转变,

sentences.en: In part, this is thanks to a new trend from America called fibermaxxing – consuming lots of fibre by eating fibre-rich foods and supplements for their health benefits.
sentences.zh: 部分地,这要归功于美国的新趋势 — — 即纤维Xxxing — — 食用大量纤维,食用富含纤维的食物,并补充其健康利益。

sentences.en: Dr Karan also gives some hacks – good solutions or pieces of advice – to help boost your fibre intake.
sentences.zh: Karan博士也提供一些黑客 — — 良好的解决方案或建议 — — 帮助提升纤维摄入量。

sentences.en: For example, adding seeds and nuts to meals.
sentences.zh: 例如,在食物中添加种子和坚果。

sentences.en: In fact, the healthiest diet is probably a balanced diet: one containing items from all the major food groups.
sentences.zh: 事实上,最健康的饮食可能是一种均衡的饮食:一种含有所有主要食品群体所提供物品的饮食。

sentences.en: But I'm still intrigued by your question, Neil.
sentences.zh: 但我还是对你的问题很感兴趣 尼尔

sentences.en: Isn't it time you revealed the answer? I asked you who the Irishman Patrick Callahan was.
sentences.zh: 我问你那个爱尔兰人帕特里克·卡拉汉是谁

sentences.en: And I said he was the winner of the Mister Universe contest.
sentences.zh: 我说他是宇宙先生比赛的赢家

sentences.en: And you were correct. Yay! OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we've learned in this episode.
sentences.zh: 好吧,让我们回顾一下我们在这集中学到的词汇。

sentences.en: If you cast your eye over something, you have a quick look at it.
sentences.zh: 如果你把眼睛投在某事上, 你快看它。

sentences.en: If something is in abundance, there's a lot or more than enough of it.
sentences.zh: 如果东西丰富, 有很多或更多的它。

sentences.en: A health halo refers to overestimating how healthy an item is based on a single feature, such as being low in calories, gluten-free or high in protein.
sentences.zh: 健康光环是指根据一个单一特征,例如卡路里低、无谷类或蛋白质高,高估一个物品的健康程度。

sentences.en: The idiom the tide is turning means that things are changing.
sentences.zh: 潮流正在转变 意味着事情在变化

sentences.en: The trend fibermaxxing means people intentionally consume lots of fibre by eating fibre-rich foods and supplements for their health benefits.
sentences.zh: 趋势纤维xxxx意味着人们通过食用富含纤维的食物和补充,蓄意消费大量纤维,以获得健康利益。

sentences.en: And finally, a hack is a good solution or piece of advice.
sentences.zh: 最后,黑客是一个很好的解决方案或建议。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up but here's another hack for you – remember you can find worksheets, quizzes and loads more resources to improve your English over on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 记住你可以找到工作表、测验结果, 并加载更多资源,

sentences.en: See you there soon, but for now it's goodbye!
sentences.zh: 一会儿见,但现在再见了!

sentences.en: Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 再见!
